# HTTP 429 Survival Kit

> Vendor-neutral defensive retry/recovery control for throttling and ambiguous outcomes.

Core rules:
- 429 is backpressure, not root-cause identification.
- Retry-After is a minimum timing floor.
- Jitter is nonnegative after server timing floors; never return earlier than Retry-After.
- operation_id stays stable while attempt_id changes.
- UNKNOWN non-idempotent outcome without an explicit provider/application idempotency contract => REOBSERVE.
- Retry budgets are bounded.
- First success after Blocked => Recovering, not automatically Healthy.

Standards snapshot: 2026-10-03.

Stable:
- RFC 6585 / 429 Too Many Requests
- RFC 9110 / Retry-After
- RFC 9457 / Problem Details

Draft:
- draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11: active draft, not RFC
- draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header-07: expired
